decisions.reason: Having survived its first test year and fitting the core salami business with low incremental cost, the premium sharing snack still offers enough upside to justify continuation.
This organic everyday item builds directly on existing processing and the firm's stated bio expansion, so management would keep the option open while market acceptance becomes clearer.
The organic sliced chicken breast line matches convenience and ingredient-conscious demand and, as a young launch, still warrants another year of learning before abandonment.

As a narrower organic salami variant in an already broad assortment, and after another organic salami extension was already abandoned, its remaining option value looks too limited relative to shelf-space and complexity costs.
